fields.System.Title: TRF-101 — Create a transfer order
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a network planner, I want to raise a transfer between two warehouses, so that stock
can be rebalanced with a proper record at both ends.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an origin warehouse, a destination warehouse, and lines, when I create a
  • transfer, then it is created with status new and a reference visible at both sites.
  • - Given the same warehouse as origin and destination, then creation is rejected.
  • - Given a product not stocked at the origin, then the line is rejected.
  • - Given the transfer, then it records an expected transit time used later by
  • [TRF-402](TRF-402-age-and-escalate-overdue.md).
  • - Given creation, then transfers.transfer_created is published.
  • - Given all timestamps, then they are stored in UTC.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | transfers, masterdata |
| Tables | transfer_order, transfer_line |
| Risks | Timezone differences producing nonsensical ordering ([doc 09 §9.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
